rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
errorPattern: declaration outputs differ from the \.ts twin: [^\n]*system\.vibe\.d\.mts
reason: With unbundle, internal/system.vibe emits internal/system.mjs beside internal/system.vibe.d.mts, so a consumer of dist/internal/system.mjs finds no declaration; the .ts twin emits internal/system.d.mts. Output names follow the native twin.
